query: 查询准时率低于0.9的供应商编号、供应商名称和准时率
gold_sql: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, on_time_rate FROM erp.supplier WHERE on_time_rate < 0.9

query: Which suppliers have an on-time delivery rate below 0.9? Show the supplier ID, supplier name and on-time rate.
gold_sql: SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, on_time_rate FROM erp.supplier WHERE on_time_rate < 0.9

query: 查询已有付款记录但尚未付清的采购单：列出采购单号、采购金额、已付款合计和未付余额
gold_sql: SELECT po.po_no, po.po_amt, SUM(p.paid_amt), po.po_amt - SUM(p.paid_amt) FROM erp.purchase_order po JOIN erp.payment p ON p.po_no = po.po_no GROUP BY po.po_no, po.po_amt HAVING SUM(p.paid_amt) < po.po_amt

query: Which purchase orders have payments recorded but are not fully paid? Show the PO number, purchase amount, total paid and unpaid balance.
gold_sql: SELECT po.po_no, po.po_amt, SUM(p.paid_amt), po.po_amt - SUM(p.paid_amt) FROM erp.purchase_order po JOIN erp.payment p ON p.po_no = po.po_no GROUP BY po.po_no, po.po_amt HAVING SUM(p.paid_amt) < po.po_amt

query: 查询订单状态为in_production的工程的生产工单号、工程号和当前工序
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT w.work_order_id, w.job_no, w.current_process FROM mes.work_order w JOIN erp.sales_order s ON w.job_no = s.job_no WHERE s.order_status = 'in_production'

query: For jobs whose sales order status is in_production, list the work order ID, job number and current process.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT w.work_order_id, w.job_no, w.current_process FROM mes.work_order w JOIN erp.sales_order s ON w.job_no = s.job_no WHERE s.order_status = 'in_production'

query: 按每种物料最新的库存快照，查询可用库存（在库数量减锁定数量）低于安全库存的物料：列出物料编码、可用库存、安全库存和计量单位
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_code, s.on_hand_qty - s.locked_qty, m.safety_stock, m.unit FROM wms.material m JOIN wms.stock_snapshot s ON s.material_code = m.material_code WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(s2.snapshot_date) FROM wms.stock_snapshot s2 WHERE s2.material_code = s.material_code) AND s.on_hand_qty - s.locked_qty < m.safety_stock

query: Using the latest stock snapshot for each material, which materials have available stock (on-hand quantity minus locked quantity) below safety stock? Show the material code, available stock, safety stock and unit.
gold_sql: SELECT m.material_code, s.on_hand_qty - s.locked_qty, m.safety_stock, m.unit FROM wms.material m JOIN wms.stock_snapshot s ON s.material_code = m.material_code WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(s2.snapshot_date) FROM wms.stock_snapshot s2 WHERE s2.material_code = s.material_code) AND s.on_hand_qty - s.locked_qty < m.safety_stock
